paite: Huan hiai thei in, ni nanung ah hun haksa pipi a hong om ding hi.
heading: Ni Nanungte
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

paite: Mi amau ki-itte, dangka deihtate, ki-uangsakte, kisatheite, Pathian gensete, nu leh pa thu mangloute, kipahna dan theiloute, siangthouloute,
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

paite: itna pianpih neiloute, buaina bawlte, hekte, kidek theiloute, mihuhamte, hoih deih hetloute,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

paite: zuautatte, kingaisang, thunung khualloute, Pathian it sang a amau kipahna kia itzawte ahi ding uh;
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

paite: Pathian limsak batna anei ding ua, himahleh athilhihtheihna ataksang kei ding uhi. Huchibang mite nungngatsan in.
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

paite: Amaute lak a khenkhatte inn peuh a lut a gitlouh gik pua numei haideuhte sal a manmante ahi ua, huchibang numeite duhgawlna chi chih a pimang in,
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

paite: zilzil napi a, thutak theipha ngeiloute ahi uhi.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

paite: Jannes leh Jambres in Mosi adou bang un, huai mite'n leng thutak adou gige uhi; lungsim sesa ginna lam a Pathian deih louh mi ahi uhi.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

paite: Himahleh huai val ahih kei ding uhi, ahaidan uh Jannes leh Jambres haidan ahong kitheih mah bang in mi tengteng kiang ah hong kilang ding hi.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

paite: Himahleh nang zaw ka thugin, ka omdan, ka thiltup, ka ginna, ka thuakzohna, ka itna, ka kuhkalna na thei vek hi,
heading: Timothi Thuhilhna
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

paite: Antiok khua, Ikoniam khua, Listra a ka tung a thil tung ahon sawinate uh, huai sawina ka thuakte; huai tengteng ah Toupa'n hon hunkheta hi.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

paite: Ahi, kuapeuh Khrist Jesu Pathian limsak a om tum photphot in sawina athuak sam ding uhi.
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

paite: Migilou leh mikhem hatte mi khem leh khem a om in agilou semsem ding uhi.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

paite: Himahleh nang zaw na zilsa leh kiptak a na gintaksa thutak ah om gige in, kua a kipan na zil hiam chih theigige in.
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

paite: Huan Khrist Jesu ginna ziak a hotdamna mu ding a nang hon hilhpil thei Laisiangthoute naupangnou a kipan thei khin na hi chih theigige in.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

paite: Laisiangthou peuhmah Pathian hatkhum a piak ahi a; huaiziak in thuhilhna ding, taihilhna ding, bawlhoihna ding, diktatna lam a kichilna ding in aphatuam hi.
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

paite: Huchi a Pathian mipa nna hoih chiteng sem ding a kimtak a kivan a akimtheihna ding in.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
